title: Changing Social Security direct deposit
facts: Social Security beneficiaries can generally change direct-deposit information through supported SSA methods, including applicable online account services.
Changing a mailing address does not automatically change the bank account used for benefit payments.
Beneficiaries should guard bank-account information and use official SSA channels because benefit-payment changes are a target for fraud.
Timing matters when closing an old account; beneficiaries should avoid assuming the next payment will automatically reach a newly opened account.
